$comment: PDIG UI vNext Design Tokens V2 — single source of truth for the vNext visual system (Global Digital Infrastructure: dark spatial · deep navy · subtle glass · premium · calm). Authority: spec/ui-vnext goal §18 baseline + Human Visual Review 2026-09-30. Change log 2026-09-30 (Human Visual Review acceptance criteria): (1) typography scale enlarged per review F (pageTitle 32-44px, section 18-22, body 15-17, secondary 13-15, <=12 only rare metadata); (2) added Earth/ocean/land/night-city-light/atmosphere-rim/star tokens for a real-Earth spatial globe (review B/E) — the plain dark sphere is demoted to LOW_POWER_FALLBACK, default renderer = bundled simplified coastlines + procedural night lights + atmosphere rim + sunlight terminator (offline, no remote tiles); (3) overview globe stage ratio tightened to 52-64% width / 64-78% height (review C); (4) glass policy: navigation/floating controls/region node/transient overlays only, data surfaces solid (review P). Any token change: reason first, spec first, then codegen. This file is presentation-only; MUST NOT alter Domain Truth; never written into .depmap frozen payload. v0.3.1 tokens in spec/ui/design-tokens.json remain frozen and untouched.

policy.colorRule: Data surfaces MUST use semantic tokens; environment layers (L0-L2) may use glass; glass MUST NOT reduce data readability (L3-L5)
policy.glassRule: glass only for navigation / floating controls / region node / transient inspector / overlay; key data areas stay solid and high contrast
policy.privacyRule: PresentationProfile is a local app preference; NEVER written into .depmap frozen payload
policy.tokenChange: reason first, spec first, then codegen
policy.visualStatus: VISUAL_CONTRACT_IMPLEMENTATION re-issued under Human Visual Review 2026-09-30; VISUAL_CRAFT = NEEDS_HUMAN_OR_VISION_REVIEW

semantic.$comment: Semantic aliases; platform code maps these roles, not raw palette names.

typography.$comment: Desktop 1920 base scale per Human Visual Review F: pageTitle 32-44, major numeric 24-36, section 18-22, body 15-17, secondary 13-15, <=12 only rare metadata.

globe.$comment: Default renderer = bundled simplified coastlines + procedural night city lights + atmosphere rim + sunlight terminator; plain shaded sphere is LOW_POWER_FALLBACK only (never default). Offline, no remote tiles.
globe.arcCountPolicy: only real cross-region relations or region infrastructure summary; never decorative

bundledData.cityLights: bundled major city coordinates for procedural night lights

nav.primaryOnly: primary rail = 现在/基础设施/变更/记录 only + 数据源/设置 at rail bottom; infrastructure secondary = top segmented context rail, never permanent equal row in sidebar

testIds.rule: same semantic id on all four platforms
